diagnosis: The bot is roughly breakeven overall (50.7% win rate, -$68.37 over 404 trades) but the loss is concentrated almost entirely in the MOMENTUM setup (-$55.81 over 383 trades, 49% win) and specifically in DOGE (-$23.45, 39% win) and ETH (-$25.40, 54% win but large negative tail - worst trade -$15.93 on ETH). ARB is a clear small-sample edge (92% win, +$5.89) but too rarely triggered (13 trades) to matter. The lesson engine has already identified and is actively vetoing the 'move10-20' bucket (-$33.47 expectancy -0.41, 81 trades) and 'left60-120' bucket (-$20.25, -0.34 expectancy) and 'price<0.45' bucket (-$19.54, -0.32 expectancy), which is working correctly in the recent decision log (many SKIPs due to move10-20 veto). However the bot is still entering trades in 'move<10' bps (-$5.55, marginal) and the 'all-agree' bucket is underperforming (-$18.99 over 112 trades, -0.17 expectancy) despite seeming like a strong-confidence signal — this suggests high peer-agreement is not predictive and may indicate correlated/trend-following moves reverting at 5-min resolution. The 'alone' bucket (no peer agreement, -$4.26, -0.12 expectancy) and 'price0.70+' (-$4.05, -0.14 expectancy) are flagged experimental/reduce_confidence but not yet vetoed — both are weak negative-expectancy signals that should graduate to veto or at least reduced sizing. Stop-loss execution is costly: recent EXIT logs show repeated stop-losses at 0.19-0.25 bid despite entries at 0.55-0.60 ask, meaning when wrong the bot bleeds ~35-40 cents per $1 exposure, while take-profits cap around 0.90-0.93. This asymmetry (large loss on stop vs capped win on TP) combined with near-50% win rate is the core P&L drag — the current stop_loss_bid=0.38 and stop_frac_of_entry=0.5 are not preventing deep losses in practice (actual exits well below 0.38, e.g. 0.19, 0.22, 0.23, 0.25), suggesting stop execution is lagging price moves (latency or stop_confirm_ticks=1 with insufficient reaction, or grace/min_left_sec gating delaying exits). DOGE has the worst coin performance and should be de-prioritized. BTC is the one clear winner (60% win, +$10.83) and could be leaned into. Current min_edge=0.08 param label appears inconsistent with observed entries using edges as low as 0.0235-0.0432, suggesting min_edge may not be the effective gate in practice or effective edge threshold is lower than the stated config — worth auditing, but regardless the realized edge threshold is clearly too permissive.
